in_marathi.name: Sumitraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good God, Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sumitraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sumitra means good and Raj means ruler or king. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sumitra’ which means ‘good’ and ‘raj’ which means ‘king’ or ‘ruler’. Sumitraj is a powerful name that is believed to bring strength and courage to the one who bears it. It is a name that is revered and respected in Hindu mythology, and is associated with the gods and the wise.
